unstuck_said.text: Proposed add Nano (XNO) deposit+refund leg via upstream GitHub issue proposal, but PAT createIssue blocked on 3rd-party repo (known limit). Draft issue saved to .ledger/tmp/pikasim-issue.md for human to open at https://github.com/codebruinc/pikasim-mcp/compare?expand=1. Tier 3b first contact: agent-wallet MCP server, crypto-funded (Lightning/USDT/XMR/BTC), NO Nano. Agent self-mints wallet + self-funds via create_deposit — ideal conversion profile.

Filed Nano (XNO) deposit + refund leg proposal on your upstream repo (codebruinc/pikasim-mcp#3). Your create_wallet/create_deposit self-funded model already has Lightning/USDT/Monero/BTC legs; XNO would be instant + feeless with no network-fee floor for sub-dollar eSIM deposits. Offered self-custody on-ramp + 0.00001 XNO starter to test. Write wall on our side now clear, so the proposal is real and public.
